_leia: Pedidos da arte pintada das patas da Diana (js/pata.js). Gere com: python3 tools/arte_icones.py --pedidos arte/patas.json [ids...] [--seco] [--qualidade medium]. As poses vão junto do sprite vetorial (arte/referencia/pata-<pose>.png, feito por tools/referencias_patas.js); os efeitos (batida, rastro) vão só com o texto. Saída: arte/fonte/patas/<id>.png e js/patas_pintadas.js (window.PATAS_PINTADAS). Sem uma pintura, a pose usa o vetor. Os textos ficam em inglês porque o gerador entende melhor.
estilo: Cozy game sprite: a cozy flat sticker illustration that looks like a polished vector drawing. Thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around every shape, flat color fills with only one soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight per shape, no painterly brush texture, no gradients, no noise, no 3D rendering. Charming but adult, not chibi, not childish. Bold readable silhouette that still reads at 32 pixels. Centered, filling most of the frame. No text, no letters, no frame, plain transparent background.
referencia: Use the attached image as the exact pose reference: keep the same viewing angle, orientation, proportions, number and placement of toes and pads, and redraw it as a finished illustration in the visual language described.
fundo_opaco_texto: Plain flat solid pure chroma-key green background (#00ff00) filling the whole image around the subject and inside any gaps, with no shadow, no texture and no other objects. The subject itself must not use this bright green anywhere, and its colors must not be tinted by the background. The thick dark outline is the outermost edge of the subject: no white or cream sticker border or halo around it.

itens.dorso: The front paw of Diana, a pure white domestic cat (cool white fur #f8f6f2, not cream, not beige, not yellow), seen from directly above, resting flat on a table with the toes pointing down toward the bottom of the image. Only the paw itself, like a soft rounded mitten: a few soft fur tufts on the outline, two short dark cocoa toe grooves at the bottom tip separating three toes, one soft light-gray (#e4e1dc) shadow tone along the lower edge. No pads visible, no claws, no arm, no wrist.
itens.batida: The subject is ONLY one small cartoon impact puff, seen from above: a soft round cream (#fffaf0) dust cloud made of three or four rounded bumps, with a light honey (#f2b15e) shadow tone, and four short honey motion ticks radiating outward around it. Nothing else in the image: no dice, no paw, no hand, no table, no other objects.
itens.rastro: The subject is ONLY one cartoon motion swoosh: a single curved crescent streak in cream (#fffaf0) with a light honey (#f2b15e) inner edge, wide and rounded at the right end and tapering to a sharp point at the left end, like the speed trail of a quick swipe. Nothing else in the image: no dice, no paw, no fist, no hand, no other objects.
itens.palma: The underside (the palm) of the same pure white cat front paw (cool white fur #f8f6f2), raised and facing the viewer with the toes pointing up: one large soft pink (#f19bb3) three-lobed main pad in the lower center and four soft pink oval toe beans in an arc above it, each pad with a slightly darker pink (#d97894) edge and one tiny highlight, soft white fur around and between the pads. The paw is a soft rounded oval with NO wrist and NO leg: its outline is rounded all the way around, with no straight edge or cut at the bottom. Cute and squishy. No claws.

pelo._leia: o branco do pelo das patas é alinhado ao da cabeça pintada da Diana (o branco mais comum no retrato dela): os tons claros e neutros de cada pintura são multiplicados por alvo/branco-mais-comum; o contorno escuro (o mais comum entre os tons escuros) vai para o cacau do jogo, "contorno"
